cards.card_text: His hour had not yet come The priests told them to wait His disciples stood in the way
cards.verse_text: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.

cards.card_text: His hour had not yet come The guards are afraid of Him The feast rules forbid it
cards.verse_text: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts, near the treasury. Yet no one seized Him, because His hour had not yet come.
